name: Hyunjin Hwang
evidence: Confirmed Hyunjin Hwang is the 4th author of arXiv 2604.06210 (verified in JaehyeokLee-119/DOVE README.md BibTeX and several arXiv-mirror repos), but no email for that person could be tied to them. A candidate address WAS found verbatim: 'hyunjinhwang@kaist.ac.kr' in https://github.com/thewebconf2026/www2026/blob/main/program/Detailed%20WebConf%202026%20Program%20-%20Session%20Chairs.csv (row: 'Graph2,Attacks & Explainability,Hyunjin Hwang,hyunjinhwang@kaist.ac.kr'). That is the KAIST Hyunjin Hwang in Kijung Shin's lab (co-author of 'On Measuring Unnoticeability of Graph Adversarial Attacks', 'Emergence of psychopathological computations in LLMs'). However the DOVE paper's other authors are SKKU (Jaehyeok Lee, JinYeong Bak), MSRA (Xiaoyuan Yi, Jing Yao, Xing Xie) and SUTD (Roy Ka-Wei Lee) - no KAIST affiliation appears - and arXiv/OpenReview/MDPI-style pages with per-author affiliations are egress-blocked here, so the identity could not be confirmed. Hyunjin Hwang is a common Korean name; applying the namesake rule strictly, reported as not found. Lead for a human to check: KAIST candidate above, LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/in/hyunjin-hwang-a4b316378/ (linked from jin-choo/HyperSearch README).
